name: Ondřej Kolář - Après le § 48 - Am 16
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Bosnia and Herzegovina
part_text: 48a. Deplores the fact that Bosnia and Herzegovina continues to serve as a key transit country for illegal migration towards the EU; stresses that its weak institutional capacity and inconsistent border management pose a persistent risk to the Member States’ internal security;
